sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收看《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件你最珍爱的传家宝去上班，把DJ台变成一个像是由美丽50年历史艺术品组成的活生生的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Helena Yang.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫海伦娜·杨。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer for the New York Times Magazine and I'm also an associate professor in emergency medicine at Columbia University.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人，也是哥伦比亚大学急诊医学的副教授。

sentences.en: This episode of The Sunday Read is a recent story of mine about an epidemic and the controversial methods that doctors recommend to contain it.
sentences.zh: 本期《周日阅读》是我最近关于一场流行病以及医生推荐的控制该流行病的争议方法的报道。

sentences.en: It's not about the coronavirus, but another epidemic.
sentences.zh: 这不是关于冠状病毒，而是另一场流行病。

sentences.en: This one arose at a surprisingly fast rate.
sentences.zh: 这场流行病以惊人的速度蔓延开来。

sentences.en: Then it worsened during the pandemic in part because of it.
sentences.zh: 然后在疫情期间恶化，部分原因也正是因为疫情。

sentences.en: And that epidemic is childhood obesity.
sentences.zh: 而这场流行病就是儿童肥胖症。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, 5% of children in the United States were considered obese.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代，美国有5%的儿童被认为患有肥胖症。

sentences.en: Today, that number is 20%.
sentences.zh: 如今，这个数字是20%。

sentences.en: And according to the CDC, severe obesity has been going up the fasteSt.
sentences.zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据，严重肥胖症的增长速度最快。

sentences.en: In response, this past January, the American Academy of Pediatrics issued guidelines telling doctors how they should screen and treat children with obesity.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，今年1月，美国儿科学会发布了指南，告诉医生应如何筛查和治疗肥胖儿童。

sentences.en: And for the first time, the AAP recommended treating all children diagnosed with obesity.
sentences.zh: 这是儿科学会首次建议治疗所有被诊断为肥胖的儿童。

sentences.en: This was new because in the past, the strategy had been watchful waiting.
sentences.zh: 这是个新变化，因为过去采取的策略一直是“严密观察，静观其变”。

sentences.en: For adolescents, the AAP presented options that had been mostly reserved for adults.
sentences.zh: 对于青少年，儿科学会提出了一些通常只留给成人的治疗选项。

sentences.en: Things like bariatric surgery, which involves removing or stapling your gastrointestinal tract or weight loss medications.
sentences.zh: 比如袖状胃切除术——这涉及切除或用钉子钉合胃肠道——或者减重药物。

sentences.en: The thinking behind bariatric surgery is that it's not the equivalent of wiring your jaw shut so you physically can't eat more food.
sentences.zh: 进行减重胃部手术的理念在于，它不等同于把你的下巴用钢丝扎死，让你物理上无法吃更多食物。

sentences.en: It's much more than that.
sentences.zh: 它要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Your hunger hormones and other chemicals change in profound ways so you can actually lose the desire to eat more.
sentences.zh: 你的饥饿激素和其他化学物质会发生深刻的变化，从而让你真正失去吃更多东西的欲望。

sentences.en: Many people felt that the AAP guidelines were too aggressive.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为儿科学会的指南过于激进。

sentences.en: Critics said that the hyper-focus on a child's weight could itself lead to eating disorders.
sentences.zh: 批评人士表示，过度关注儿童的体重本身就可能导致进食障碍。

sentences.en: The screening methods for obesity used a measurement of BMI, or body mass index.
sentences.zh: 用于肥胖的筛查方法使用的是BMI测量值，即身体质量指数。

sentences.en: Some questioned that number altogether, saying that the standards for a, quote, healthy BMI were set based on a white European male population, ignoring variations in race,
sentences.zh: 一些人完全质疑这个数字，称所谓的“健康BMI”标准是以白人欧洲男性人口为基础设定的，忽略了种族的变化，

sentences.en: ethnicity, and gender.
sentences.zh: 族裔和性别。

sentences.en: There's also an additional controversy because some of the studies that have been done on the ties between obesity and life expectancy have arrived at different results,
sentences.zh: 这也存在额外的争议，因为一些关于肥胖与预期寿命之间联系的研究得出了不同的结果，

sentences.en: depending on the controls.
sentences.zh: 这取决于对照组的选择。

sentences.en: So the eating disorder community was asking, if we're not even positive that being obese has consequences on our health and on our life expectancy,
sentences.zh: 因此，进食障碍社群不禁发问，如果我们甚至不能确定肥胖是否真的会对我们的健康和预期寿命产生影响，

sentences.en: why are we even making people endure these treatments?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们还要让人们忍受这些治疗呢？

sentences.en: What many critics latched onto were the AAP's recommendations for invasive treatments, particularly bariatric surgery,
sentences.zh: 许多批评人士抓住不放的是儿科学会对侵入性治疗的建议，特别是减重手术，

sentences.en: saying that kids' brains aren't developed enough to understand the fallout.
sentences.zh: 他们认为孩子的大脑发育得还不够成熟，无法理解其后果。

sentences.en: Yes, maybe you're eating smaller meals, but also you're taking vitamins for the rest of your life.
sentences.zh: 是的，也许你吃的饭变少了，但同时你余生都得靠吃维生素维系。

sentences.en: You can't grow back the part of your stomach that's cut out.
sentences.zh: 你被切除的那部分胃是无法重新长出来的。

sentences.en: It's permanently gone.
sentences.zh: 它永远消失了。

sentences.en: As a physician, I had seen lots of articles written about adults getting bariatric surgery, but I hadn't seen an in-depth one about children.
sentences.zh: 作为一名医生，我见过很多关于成年人做减重手术的文章，但我还没有见过关于儿童的深入报道。

sentences.en: I then met Alexandra Duarte, who is one of the main characters in the story you're about to hear.
sentences.zh: 随后我遇到了亚历山德拉·杜阿尔特，她是你即将听到的故事中的主角之一。

sentences.en: Alexandra had just turned 16 when I met her.
sentences.zh: 我遇到亚历山德拉时，她刚满16岁。

sentences.en: She told me that ever since she was a toddler, she always had some extra weight.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，从幼儿时期开始，她身上就一直有些超重。

sentences.en: She also had a condition called polycystic ovary syndrome, which contributed to her obesity.
sentences.zh: 她还患有一种名为多囊卵巢综合征的疾病，这加剧了她的肥胖。

sentences.en: Alexandra's doctors mentioned bariatric surgery, and her mother was interested from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉的医生提到了减重手术，她的母亲从一开始就很感兴趣。

sentences.en: She had seen how it helped her adult friends.
sentences.zh: 她亲眼见证过这如何帮助了她的成年朋友。

sentences.en: Until then, Alexandra had tried all manner of things, from diet pills to fasting, in order to control her weight.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，亚历山德拉尝试过各种方法，从减肥药到禁食，以此来控制体重。

sentences.en: She had suffered through the teasing and bullying at school, and she was determined to do something.
sentences.zh: 她饱受学校里的戏弄和欺凌之苦，她决心做点什么。

sentences.en: Only now, her doctor was recommending an extreme surgery that would take months to prepare for, take away around 80% of her stomach, and have lifelong consequences.
sentences.zh: 只是这一次，她的医生推荐了一场需要几个月准备、切除约80%胃部且会带来终身后果的极端手术。

sentences.en: So here's my article, Bariatric Surgery at 16, read by Sonila Nankani.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章《16岁的减重手术》，由索尼拉·南卡尼朗读。

sentences.en: The audio for this episode was produced by Tali Abacassas, and original music was composed and performed by Aaron Esquizito.
sentences.zh: 本集的音频由塔利·阿巴卡萨斯制作，原创音乐由亚伦·埃斯基西托创作和演奏。

sentences.en: Last fall, Alexandra Duarte, who is now 16, went to see her endocrinologist at Texas Children's Hospital outside Houston.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，现年16岁的亚历山德拉·杜阿尔特去休斯敦郊外的得克萨斯州儿童医院看她的内分泌学家。

sentences.en: From age 10, she had been living with polycystic ovary syndrome, and more recently, pre-diabetes.
sentences.zh: 从10岁起，她就一直在与多囊卵巢综合征共存，最近还患上了糖尿病前期。

sentences.en: After Alexandra described her recent quinceanera, the doctor brought up an operation that might benefit her,
sentences.zh: 在亚历山德拉描述了她最近的成人礼派对后，医生提起了一项可能对她有益的手术，

sentences.en: one that might help her lose weight, and as a result, improve these obesity-related probleMs.
sentences.zh: 一项可能帮她减重、并因此改善这些与肥胖相关的问题的手术。

sentences.en: Alexandra, who smiles shyly and speaks softly but confidently, says she was a little skeptical at first, because, like, it's a surgery.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉羞涩地微笑着，说话轻声细语却透着自信，她说她起初有点怀疑，因为，这毕竟是个手术。

sentences.en: But her mother, Gabriela Vélez, suggested that her daughter consider it.
sentences.zh: 但她的母亲加布里埃拉·贝莱斯建议女儿考虑一下。

sentences.en: Ever since I was a toddler, my mom knew that I was struggling with obesity, Alexandra says.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉说：“从我很小的时候起，我妈妈就知道我一直在与肥胖作斗争。”

sentences.en: Through the years, Alexandra seemed to have tried everything.
sentences.zh: 多年来，亚历山德拉似乎尝试过所有方法。

sentences.en: She went through periods when she avoided all carbs, and days when she drank only water.
sentences.zh: 她经历过不吃任何碳水化合物的时期，也有过整天只喝水的日子。

sentences.en: She turned to commercial products, from Herbalife to diet pills to meal replacement shakes.
sentences.zh: 她求助于商业产品，从康宝莱到减肥药再到代餐奶昔。

sentences.en: Desperation and hope led her to try gimmicky lotions that promised to burn fat.
sentences.zh: 绝望与希望促使她尝试那些承诺能燃烧脂肪的噱头乳液。

sentences.en: Puberty seemed to make things worse.
sentences.zh: 青春期似乎让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: Her doctors dispensed basically the same talk everyone else gives me, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说，她的医生们给出的基本上和所有人对她说的一样的话。

sentences.en: Follow the government's MyPlate plan.
sentences.zh: 遵循政府的“我的餐盘”计划。

sentences.en: Eat lots of vegetables.
sentences.zh: 多吃蔬菜。

sentences.en: Have anything, but don't overdo it.
sentences.zh: 什么都可以吃，但不要过量。

sentences.en: Her mother diligently prepared her meals, cooking vegetables in ways that she liked.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲勤恳地为她准备饭菜，用她喜欢的方式烹饪蔬菜。

sentences.en: Alexandra herself worked on getting fuller on less, trying to limit each meal to a single plateful.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉自己也努力做到少吃而饱，试图把每顿饭限制在一个盘子的分量内。

sentences.en: Almost everyone in her immediate family carries extra weight, including her younger twin brothers, who put on more weight during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 她直系亲属中的几乎所有人都有超重问题，包括她那在疫情期间体重增加更多的双胞胎弟弟。

sentences.en: But neither her father, nor the twins, nor another brother copied her efforts.
sentences.zh: 但无论是她的父亲、双胞胎弟弟，还是另一个兄弟，都没有效仿她的努力。

sentences.en: Seeing them eat ice cream and cake made her vegetables less enticing.
sentences.zh: 看着他们吃冰淇淋和蛋糕，让她觉得自己的蔬菜更不诱人了。

sentences.en: I have a huge sweet tooth, she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我特别爱吃甜食。”

sentences.en: The teasing started in fifth grade.
sentences.zh: 戏弄从五年级开始了。

sentences.en: Alexandra couldn't eat without her classmates staring at and judging her.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉吃饭时，同学们总会盯着她并对她评头论足。

sentences.en: Though she sought counseling for her sadness and anxiety, these troubles still caused her to leave school for a month.
sentences.zh: 尽管她曾因悲伤和焦虑寻求心理咨询，但这些困扰仍然导致她离开学校一个月。

sentences.en: The bullying finally stopped after she switched schools in 10th grade.
sentences.zh: 在10年级转学后，欺凌终于停止了。

sentences.en: But Alexandra's parents knew how deeply she continued to suffer.
sentences.zh: 但亚历山德拉的父母深知她所承受的痛苦有多深。

sentences.en: How much more could their daughter endure?
sentences.zh: 他们的女儿还能再忍受多少？

sentences.en: After the doctor suggested bariatric surgery, an operation on the gastrointestinal tract that helps patients lose weight,
sentences.zh: 在医生建议进行减重手术（一项有助于患者减重的胃肠道手术）之后，

sentences.en: they spoke to friends who had successfully been through the procedure as adults.
sentences.zh: 他们咨询了作为成年人成功经历过这一手术的朋友。

sentences.en: They decided it was a smart option for her.
sentences.zh: 他们决定这对她来说是一个明智的选择。

sentences.en: Alexandra wasn't sure, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，亚历山德拉并不确信。

sentences.en: When the family met the surgeon, Jose Ruben Rodriguez, he was quick to tell them that the operation was no shortcut.
sentences.zh: 当全家见到外科医生何塞·鲁本·罗德里格斯时，他直截了当地告诉他们，这台手术绝不是什么捷径。

sentences.en: Indeed, Alexandra first had to complete the hospital's strict, comprehensive behavior and lifestyle program, which lasts six to nine months.
sentences.zh: 事实上，亚历山德拉首先必须完成该医院严格、全面的行为与生活方式项目，该项目持续六到九个月。

sentences.en: This effort would demonstrate her commitment to improving her health while also preparing her for surgery and life afterward.
sentences.zh: 这项努力将展现她改善健康的决心，同时也为她接下来的手术及术后生活做好准备。

sentences.en: Many teenagers find this step too challenging.
sentences.zh: 许多青少年发现这一步太具挑战性。

sentences.en: Rodriguez estimates that less than one-third of them end up receiving the surgery after their initial appointment.
sentences.zh: 罗德里格斯估计，在初次面诊后，最终真正接受手术的人不到三分之一。

sentences.en: For Alexandra, the program's tasks mimicked what she had tried already, keeping food journals, drinking more water, setting sleep schedules,
sentences.zh: 对亚历山德拉而言，该项目的内容与她之前尝试过的模仿得很像：写食物日记、多喝水、设定睡眠时间表，

sentences.en: which in turn often means restricting access to phones.
sentences.zh: 这通常也意味着限制使用手机。

sentences.en: She was also instructed to exercise.
sentences.zh: 她还被指导进行锻炼。

sentences.en: As someone who loves dancing to K-pop songs in her bedroom and going to the gym with friends,
sentences.zh: 作为一名喜欢在卧室里伴着K-pop歌曲跳舞、和朋友一起去健身房的人，

sentences.en: Alexandra didn't find that difficult either.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉也并不觉得这有什么难的。

sentences.en: I guess for some people it could be intense, she says, but it honestly, to me, felt a little bit easy.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我想对某些人来说这可能很紧张，但老实说，对我来说感觉有点容易。”

sentences.en: Alexandra also saw a dietician, a psychologist, a gynecologist, and a social worker.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉还看了一位营养师、一位心理学家、一位妇科医生和一位社工。

sentences.en: She was tested too.
sentences.zh: 她还接受了各项检查。

sentences.en: Blood draws, ultrasound, x-rays, sleep study.
sentences.zh: 抽血、超声波、X光、睡眠监测。

sentences.en: With each appointment, she felt increasingly comfortable with the prospect of an operation.
sentences.zh: 随着每一次预约，她对即将手术的前景感到越来越安心。

sentences.en: It was especially helpful to hear Rodriguez explain the procedure called a sleeve gastrectomy and describe the experiences of other teenagers who had been through it.
sentences.zh: 听罗德里格斯解释名为“袖状胃切除术”的手术过程，并听他描述其他经历过该手术的青少年的经历，这特别有帮助。

sentences.en: After several months of deliberating, she decided to go ahead.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的深思熟虑，她决定继续进行手术。

sentences.en: The other would-be fixes never really solved the problem, Alexandra says.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉说，其他那些所谓能解决问题的办法从未真正解决过问题。

sentences.en: No matter how many pounds I lose, I gain it back.
sentences.zh: 不管我减掉多少磅，我都会胖回来。

sentences.en: And it's sometimes even more.
sentences.zh: 而且有时甚至比以前更胖。

sentences.en: It made me feel discouraged with my efforts.
sentences.zh: 这让我对自己的努力感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Like maybe I wasn't trying hard enough.
sentences.zh: 就好像我付出的努力还不够似的。

sentences.en: Alexandra is one of the roughly 20% of children in the United States living with obesity, up from 5% in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉是美国大约20%患有肥胖症的儿童之一，高于20世纪70年代的5%。

sentences.en: Another 16% or so are considered overweight.
sentences.zh: 大约还有16%的人被认为是超重。

sentences.en: The prevalence of obesity increases as children get older, to more than 22% among adolescents, from around 13% in 2- to 5-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 随着儿童年龄的增长，肥胖的患病率也在增加，在青少年中超过22%，而2至5岁儿童中这一比例约为13%。

sentences.en: At 5'1 and 209 pounds,
sentences.zh: 身高5英尺1英寸（约1.55米）、体重209磅（约95公斤），

sentences.en: Alexandra had a body mass index that placed her well above the threshold for severe obesity, which is 120% of the 95th percentile,
sentences.zh: 根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的儿童青少年年龄BMI延长生长图表，

sentences.en: according to the CDC's extended BMI for age growth chart.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉的身体质量指数远远超过了严重肥胖的阈值，即第95百分位数的120%。

sentences.en: Without treatment,
sentences.zh: 如果不接受治疗，

sentences.en: Alexandra would almost inevitably have obesity into adulthood.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉几乎不可避免地会带着肥胖进入成年期。

sentences.en: And the longer that continued, the more at risk she would be for chronic health issues, like joint pain and problems with breathing and sleeping.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续的时间越长，她患上慢性健康问题（如关节痛、呼吸和睡眠问题）的风险就越大。

sentences.en: Worse, some children in her situation can develop what were once considered adult illnesses.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，她这种情况的一些儿童可能会患上曾被认为是成年人才有的疾病。

sentences.en: Hypertension, diabetes, fatty liver disease.
sentences.zh: 高血压、糖尿病、脂肪肝。

sentences.en: Obesity can also magnify mental health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 肥胖还会放大心理健康问题。

sentences.en: Teenagers with obesity are more likely than those without obesity to contemplate suicide.
sentences.zh: 患有肥胖症的青少年比没有肥胖症的青少年更有可能产生自杀意念。

sentences.en: Severe obesity is the fastest rising subcategory among youth, an epidemic within an epidemic, as the American Academy of Pediatrics calls it.
sentences.zh: 严重肥胖是青少年中增长最快的子类别，正如美国儿科学会所称，这是一场“流行病中的流行病”。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, the rate of increase in children's BMI doubled.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，儿童BMI的增长速度翻了一番。
